rho_reference.note: band for 32 b, T = 16384 (medians over 22 configurations). strongest_available means the strongest rho in this harness: the validator found no stronger one (kappa 0.75/1.0 and rho2x without retention never win); it is not ecbench's rho.multitarget_pooled. The order flips across the band (IC dearer at h = 0, cheaper at h = 1), so every section 5a decision is unranked; the admitted row reports that, with the distance remaining.
